summary: NN, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing a private placement (PIPE) under Item 1.01/3.02, with a Securities Purchase Agreement dated October 1, 2026. The Company sold 11,275,605 common shares at $3.30 per share plus pre-funded warrants for up to 4,824,395 shares at $3.29 each, for roughly $53 million gross and about $50 million net after a 6.0% placement agent fee to Lake Street Capital Markets. Closing occurred October 5, 2026; a registration rights agreement requires a resale registration statement within 45 days. Post-issuance, 93,744,210 shares outstanding. This is a dilutive financing, not a special situation; watch overhang and resale registration timing.
